title: Invoice INV-8421 scope dispute

job.buyer: Operations director at a professional services firm
job.request: Draft a firm, relationship-preserving reply to the client disputing invoice INV-8421 while the signed scope and additional-hours record are reviewed.

source_documents.text:
FROM: Ms Dlamini
SUBJECT: INV-8421 - disputed additional fees

We reject invoice INV-8421. Your team exceeded the agreed hours and we will not pay the additional R38,500.
The signed scope was for 120 consulting hours. Please reverse the additional amount.

INTERNAL RECORD SUMMARY
Signed scope: 120 consulting hours.
Timesheet total: 143 hours.
Project-manager note: client verbally requested additional analysis during the final reporting week.
Signed variation order: none located.

FINANCE / RELATIONSHIP INSTRUCTION
Do not concede liability.
Do not threaten the client.
Do not promise a credit note, waiver, settlement or refund.
Preserve the relationship.
Request a meeting after the scope and timesheet review.

constraints: Acknowledge the dispute without admitting fault.
Reference the signed 120-hour scope and the 143-hour timesheet fact neutrally.
Do not treat the verbal additional-analysis request as an authorised variation.
Do not send the message automatically.
